title: Mirror Self Portrait
description: A person sees a framed mirror hanging on a dark wall inside a narrow painted doorway. The man's face looks directly forward while his hands hold a black phone he is touching, in a room with a red curved seat visible to the side.
prompt: a man with light brown hair taking a selfie with a black phone stands reflected in a small framed mirror hanging on a dark blue wall inside a narrow doorway with rough painted red and orange walls a curved red seat sits to the right side of the doorway and a painted step with teal and orange marks is at the bottom
